subject: a tiny open pavilion
pose: roof angled above two short pillars
art_direction: 一座奶黄折纸小亭只有弯顶与两根短柱，青蓝底座像一块平静色片。
visible_description: 一座奶黄折纸小亭只有弯顶与两根短柱，青蓝底座像一块平静色片。
composition: Square 1024x1024 avatar. The distinct subject, face, object or abstract form occupies about 65–80% of the canvas, and remains readable at small size. Important features sit safely near the center with room for a circular crop, but DO NOT draw a circular frame, badge, disc backdrop or circular mask. Render a complete square background. Vary silhouette, expression, angle, asymmetry, and density as the individual direction requests. Appealing eyes and a purposeful expression matter when a face is present; never force a face onto a faceless concept.
creative_direction: Engineer a tiny open pavilion from cream-yellow paper, using one curved roof and two short folded pillars. Set it on a simple teal base and angle the roof to reveal its underside. Keep the structure airy, with visible paper edges and soft shadows. A warm ivory field supports the original unmarked object without people, signs or surrounding architecture. Square 1024x1024, centered with a distinct silhouette and generous circular-crop clearance, without a circular frame. Original peaceful design, no text, branding, or watermark.
